item.title: Mitarashi Dango: Takayama's Savoury Grilled Rice Dumplings — Guide
item.description: Mitarashi dango are skewered rice dumplings grilled over charcoal and glazed with soy sauce, and Takayama’s version is distinctive for being savoury rather than the sweet, syrupy style found in much of the rest of Japan, brushed simply with a soy-based sauce and grilled until fragrant. Sold hot from street stalls along the old town’s lanes, they are a popular, inexpensive snack to eat while walking, the smell of the grilling dango a familiar part of the Sanmachi Suji atmosphere.
